info.title: Insights Management
info.description:
The Insights Management API provides sellers with actionable information to optimize their listings:
*   Sellers can locate best-selling items with Trending Items API so they can add those to their catalog of item offerings. 
*   Sellers can find out reasons why items go unpublished, fix the issue and republish those items.
*   Sellers can use Listing Quality APIs to gather listing quality metrics about their items and identify any issues that they can fix.
*   Sellers can obtain their overall Listing Quality score, and locate any categories that show items with listing quality issues.

get.summary: Pro Seller Tier and Rewards Status
get.description:
Call this endpoint to retrieve your Pro Seller tier and rewards status based on your account’s current standing in Walmart’s Pro Seller program.

You can retrieve:
- Your tier (Rising, Advanced, or Pro Seller) and next eligible tier.
- Badge enrollment and award state.
- Evaluation window timing, including the next refresh date.
- Performance criteria details (targets vs. current values).
- Active rewards (for example, fee incentives).

Use this endpoint to automate Pro Seller status updates and avoid visiting Seller Center to check your tier and rewards.

Refresh cadence: Tier status refreshes twice monthly on the 5th and 20th of each month. Use `nextRefreshDate` to time polling and dashboards.

Mexico market note: Only the Pro Seller level is available.

`criteriaTier` shows the tier level each metric has met. To earn a tier status by `nextRefreshDate`, all `criteriaTier` values must be equivalent to or higher than the tier you want.

For more information and usage examples, refer to the API guide: https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/retrieve-pro-seller-tier-status-and-reward-details
